name: OmaDocker
author: Kayo Oliveira
description: Docker containers in the Omarchy bar: what is running, what died, live CPU and memory, and start/stop/restart/logs without a terminal.

barWidget.description: Groups containers by Compose project, shows live CPU and memory for the running ones, and starts, stops, restarts or tails the logs of any of them from the panel.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar glyph re-reads Docker. The panel refreshes every 3 seconds while it is open, regardless of this.

schema.label: Show stopped containers
schema.description: Off lists only running containers, which keeps the panel short on a machine with a long history of one-off runs.

schema.label: Show CPU and memory
schema.description: Off skips the docker stats call entirely. Worth turning off on a laptop: sampling every running container costs about a second of work each time the panel is open.

schema.label: Hide the bar icon when there are no containers
schema.description: On removes the button from the bar until Docker has something to show.
